paragraphs: Sunbeam School Ballia has successfully fulfilled the need of a school which propagates education to inculcate the confidence in students to be global citizens yet be rooted to their culture and traditions.
Sunbeam Ballia is geared with the best of infrastructure and has achieved new benchmarks in school education in the district.
The school has been providing well-rounded holistic education to the students residing in and around the city of Ballia.

Sunbeam Ballia has the proud privilege of providing a unique platform to young sportsmen by conducting Zonal and State Championships from time to time. Our students have grabbed prestigious positions in the state and have participated at the National level as well.
I welcome you all to Sunbeam Ballia.
credentials: EdLEAP: Education Leader Program from IIM Calcutta

paragraphs: The Sunbeam vision has always been to empower students with 21st-century skills while staying rooted in Indian culture and moral values. We are committed to holistic development — intellectual growth, physical well-being, emotional resilience and ethical strength.
As Principal, my role is to ensure that every child feels valued, safe, and inspired to achieve their full potential.

cipher: I become your thought and your vision the moment you embrace me. I illuminate your path and guide you on your onward Journey. I was conceptualized and put into my form in the year 1972, when Sunbeam was established and the journey there on has been tremendous.
All Sunbeams are open books with transparency in thought and action and an honest affirmation. They are learners and keep their slates clean to constantly learn and evolve.
greeting: Sunbeam schools not only use this as a greeting but also a way of life where all aspects of patriotism are nurtured and felt to be visible in every little act of Sunbeams. Sunbeams feel strongly for their nation and stand up proudly for it in all their acts.
Jai Hind, is more than a salutation from Sunbeams to others reiterating the pride they take of being an Indian and everything that comes along with that identity.

sections.label: 01 — Our Vision
body: Ongoing consolidation, growth and collaboration within and across institutions that are instrumental in *holistic growth of students*, in a conducive environment, that promotes *excellence* and the students further move on to *refine the social fabric*.

sections.label: 02 — Jai Hind, the greeting
sections.heading: Jai Hind
body: All Sunbeams live and abide by the ethos of Jai Hind.

sections.label: 03 — The Cipher letter
sections.note: The order matters: the page sets these around the two Cipher paragraphs — salute (two lines), paragraph one, the quote, the Duty/Devotion/Discipline line, paragraph two, the three colours, then the closing and the footnote.
body: A single sunbeam is enough to drive away many shadows.

My innumerable rays or Sunbeams* are shaping the destiny of mankind through their diverse capabilities steeped into the spirit of **Duty** towards self, society and nation, **Devotion** towards righteous work and **Discipline** to walk down the right path, not getting swayed by temptations.
So … come be the Sunbeam and take forward my legacy … Shine each day and let the world shine in your reflected glory…
* A student studying in any Sunbeam Institution, or an alumnus, is called a **Sunbeam**.

sections.label: 03 — The three colours
sections.note: The name is what the page keys its palette off — Red, Blue and Yellow each have a hex in the stylesheet. Renaming one leaves it uncoloured.

points.title: Red
points.body: The RED in me is the youthful energy and vigor that I channelize into substantial output.

points.title: Blue
points.body: The BLUE symbolizes trust, loyalty, wisdom, confidence, intelligence, faith and a never ending quest for perfection and excellence.

points.title: Yellow
points.body: YELLOW, the color of sunshine, hope, and happiness which Sunbeam spread all over.

history: Established in 2013, Sunbeam School, Agarsanda, Ballia has grown into one of the district’s leading educational institutions, evolving from a humble beginning of 456 students to a thriving community of 2,700+ learners from Nursery to Class XII. A Co-educational Senior Secondary School affiliated with CBSE, New Delhi, the school offers PCM, PCB, Commerce and Humanities, providing students with diverse pathways to discover their interests, pursue their aspirations and prepare for an ever-changing world. At Sunbeam School Ballia, education extends far beyond the classroom. Over the years, the school has built a strong reputation for academic excellence, value-based education and holistic development, creating an environment where every learner is encouraged to question, explore, create and excel.

With a vibrant campus, experienced educators, progressive teaching methodologies and excellent infrastructure, Sunbeam School strives to provide an enriching learning experience that nurtures knowledge, character, confidence and leadership. Rooted in the guiding values of Duty, Devotion and Discipline, the school encourages students to participate and excel across academics, sports, cultural pursuits, leadership and life skills. Today, with a growing community of 2,700+ students, Sunbeam School, Agarsanda, Ballia continues its journey with a clear purpose — to educate the future, inspire excellence and empower every learner to make a meaningful difference in the world.

voices.name: Mr. Sanjai Kumar Pandey
voices.alt: Mr. Sanjai Kumar Pandey, Chairman of Sunbeam School Ballia.
paragraphs: Sunbeam School Ballia has effectively played a pivotal role in spreading the Sunbeam Education revolution in the district for last 7 years. I congratulate the entire team of Management, staff members, students and last but not the least the parents of the school for this success of Sunbeam Ballia.

Education is a continuous life long process which begins at the early stage of life from a school till one enters the last stage of life. The aim & objective of a school is to instill in the students the qualities of a genuine human and concerns of society. Sunbeam School Ballia fulfills these commitments to realize the welfare of not only an individual but society & country at a large. To realize this we offer many co-curricular activities which help to unfold the hidden talents of our students.
I would like to offer my sincere thanks to all the parents & well-wishers for their support & co-operation.

voices.name: Mr. Shriwats Singh
voices.alt: Mr. Shriwats Singh, Secretary of Sunbeam School Ballia.
paragraphs: Learning is not a process limited to school & colleges only. It is indeed a never ending process and the school is the first orientation of formal education of a child. We all agree that the youth of future generation are going to face more pressure in all spheres. It is the demand of our time to prepare global students for a better world.
I am happy to share that Sunbeam School Ballia has been facilitating students for the all round progress & character building.
